rows.grounds: qualifies the deities as forming an enclosure

items.question: Which six limb-deities constitute the surrounding enclosure upon the petals?
premises: The petals serve as the locus of placement.
Six limbs are identified as distinct entities.
These entities function as surrounding deities.
items.inference: The six limbs are established as the surrounding deities located on the petals.
uncertainties: The precise referents of the six limbs depend on the wider ritual context.
items.plain_english: The six limbs are the surrounding deities on the petals.
